title: Housing Geospatial — Quantile Regression with OSMnx Enrichment

modules.dataset: Indian metro housing ETL with 7 OSM POI proximity features (metro/hospital/school/park/mall/bus_stop/commercial_hub). Synthetic Mumbai generator with realistic price gradients. OSMnx enrichment with synthetic fallback when network unavailable.
modules.model: Quantile regression (LightGBM + GradientBoostingRegressor) producing p10/p50/p90 predictions. Pinball loss + 80% interval coverage + crossing-rate diagnostics. Non-crossing post-fix in QuantileModel.predict.
modules.visualize: Spatial price heatmap (log-scale), OSM proximity small-multiples, quantile prediction intervals, coverage calibration bar chart.
modules.tests: 14 tests: pinball math (4 hand-crafted cases), haversine vs geopy, schema verification, model training shape, perfect-interval coverage=1.0, zero-coverage case, viz rendering, CLI smoke

entry_point: python train.py [--metro mumbai|delhi|bangalore] [--models lightgbm gradient_boosting] [--use-osm] --metrics-json metrics.json
